
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/du-hong/p/19015284" title="发布于 2025-10-31 09:34">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">《刚刚问世》系列初窥篇-Java+Playwright自动化测试-31- 操作日历时间控件-上篇（详细教程）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3 id="autoid-0-0-0">1.简介</h3>
<p>我们在实际工作或者生活中，有可能遇到有些web产品，网页上有一些时间选择，然后支持按照不同时间段范围去筛选数据，例如：我们预定火车票或者预定酒店，需要选择发车日期或者酒店的入住与退房时间。宏哥早在之前的12306选出发站就简单的提到过，只不过是一带而过，今天就展开详细介绍一下。网页上日历控件一般，是一个文本输入框，鼠标点击，就会弹出日历界面，可以选择具体日期。这一篇，宏哥就来介绍一下日历控件是如何用Playwright实现自动化。</p>
<h3 id="autoid-0-1-0">2.JQueryUI网站</h3>
<h4 id="autoid-0-2-0">2.1被测网址</h4>
<p>1.被测网址的地址：</p>
<p>&nbsp;<a href="https://jqueryui.com/resources/demos/checkboxradio/default.html" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://jqueryui.com/resources/demos/checkboxradio/default.html</a></p>
<p>2.网页如下图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202507/1232840-20250731160429157-256954089.gif" alt="GIF 2025-7-31 16-03-56" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="autoid-0-2-1">3.方法一</h3>
<p>宏哥这里提供两种方法，其他的基本上都是围绕这两种方法进行拆解和处理的。第一种方法：比较简单直接将日历控件看作是文本输入框，直接按照日期格式输入就可以了（马上国庆节了，宏哥直接输入25年的国庆节，这种方式还是比较简单容易上手的）。</p>
<h4 id="autoid-0-3-0">3.1代码设计</h4>
<p>根据第一种思路进行代码设计如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202507/1232840-20250731152017381-1191777819.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 id="autoid-0-3-1">3.2参考代码</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">package</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.bjhg.playwright;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.Browser;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.BrowserContext;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.BrowserType;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.Page;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.Playwright;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
 * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@author</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 北京-宏哥
 * 
 * @公众号:北京宏哥（微信搜索，关注宏哥，提前解锁更多测试干货）
 * 
 * 《刚刚问世》系列初窥篇-Java+Playwright自动化测试-31- 操作日历时间控件-上篇
 *
 * 2025年08月04日
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Test_calendar {

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TODO Auto-generated method stub</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (Playwright playwright =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Playwright.create()) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">1.使用chromium浏览器，# 浏览器配置，设置以GUI模式启动Chrome浏览器（要查看浏览器UI，在启动浏览器时传递 headless=false 标志。您还可以使用 slowMo 来减慢执行速度。</span>
            Browser browser = playwright.chromium().launch(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BrowserType.LaunchOptions().setHeadless(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>).setSlowMo(300<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">2.创建context</span>
            BrowserContext context =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> browser.newContext();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">创建page</span>
            Page page =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.newPage();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">3.浏览器访问demo</span>
            page.navigate("http://jqueryui.com/resources/demos/datepicker/default.html"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            Thread.sleep(</span>100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">4.定位日历的输入框，并输入国庆节：2025-10-01</span>
            page.locator("#datepicker").fill("2025-10-01"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            System.out.println(</span>"Test Pass"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">5.关闭page</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            page.close();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">6.关闭browser</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            browser.close();
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (InterruptedException e) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TODO Auto-generated catch block</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h4 id="autoid-0-3-2">3.3运行代码</h4>
<div>1.运行代码，右键Run As-&gt;Java Application，就可以看到控制台输出，如下图所示：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202507/1232840-20250731153510829-655956817.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<div>2.运行代码后电脑端的浏览器的动作（日期控件的输入框直接输入国庆节，看不清的小伙伴或者童鞋们可以自己在关闭浏览器前加一个等待即可）。如下图所示：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202507/1232840-20250731154019316-1938362544.gif" alt="GIF+2025-7-31+15-38-05" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<div>
<h3 id="autoid-0-3-3">4.方法二</h3>
<p>第二种方法：一种笨办法，通过元素定位，采用编写的Java脚本模拟手工操作一样，将日期一步一步选择点击出来。</p>
<h4 id="autoid-0-4-0">4.1代码设计</h4>
<p>根据第二种思路进行代码设计如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202507/1232840-20250731160027797-639774827.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<div>
<h4 id="autoid-0-4-0">4.2参考代码</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">package</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.bjhg.playwright;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.Browser;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.BrowserContext;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.BrowserType;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.Page;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> com.microsoft.playwright.Playwright;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
 * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@author</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 北京-宏哥
 * 
 * @公众号:北京宏哥（微信搜索，关注宏哥，提前解锁更多测试干货）
 * 
 * 《刚刚问世》系列初窥篇-Java+Playwright自动化测试-31- 操作日历时间控件-上篇
 *
 * 2025年08月04日
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Test_calendar {

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TODO Auto-generated method stub</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span> (Playwright playwright =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Playwright.create()) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">1.使用chromium浏览器，# 浏览器配置，设置以GUI模式启动Chrome浏览器（要查看浏览器UI，在启动浏览器时传递 headless=false 标志。您还可以使用 slowMo 来减慢执行速度。</span>
            Browser browser = playwright.chromium().launch(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BrowserType.LaunchOptions().setHeadless(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>).setSlowMo(500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">2.创建context</span>
            BrowserContext context =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> browser.newContext();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">创建page</span>
            Page page =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.newPage();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">3.浏览器访问demo</span>
            page.navigate("http://jqueryui.com/resources/demos/datepicker/default.html"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            Thread.sleep(</span>100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">4.定位日历的并点击输入框，</span>
            page.locator("#datepicker"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).click();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">点击下一个月8月,因为宏哥是7月份写的，所有需要点击到10月份</span>
            page.locator("//*[@id='ui-datepicker-div']/div/a[@data-handler='next']"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).click();    
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">点击下一个月9月</span>
            page.locator("//*[@id='ui-datepicker-div']/div/a[@data-handler='next']"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).click();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">点击下一个月10月</span>
            page.locator("//*[@id='ui-datepicker-div']/div/a[@data-handler='next']"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).click();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">xpath定义第二行第六个元素，可能每个月排序不一样，所以不一定点击的就是01日（2025-10-01）</span>
            page.locator("//*[@id='ui-datepicker-div']/table/tbody/tr[1]/td[4]/a"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).click();
            System.out.println(</span>"Test Pass"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">5.关闭page</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            page.close();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">6.关闭browser</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            browser.close();
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (InterruptedException e) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TODO Auto-generated catch block</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h4 id="autoid-0-3-2">4.3运行代码</h4>
<div>1.运行代码，右键Run As-&gt;Java Application，就可以看到控制台输出，如下图所示：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202507/1232840-20250731160048150-1934345597.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
</div>
<div>2.运行代码后电脑端的浏览器的动作（日期控件的输入框直接输入国庆节）。如下图所示：</div>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1232840/202507/1232840-20250731155938762-528798064.gif" alt="GIF+2025-7-31+15-57-31" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="autoid-0-4-3">5.小结</h3>
